Electivire

Electric

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Electivire is an Electric-type Thunderbolt Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 138.6 kg. It evolves from Electabuzz. Its highest base stat is Attack (123), with a base stat total of 540.
